title: Brick Blaster
description: The definitive retro-futuristic breakout experience! Shatter prismatic block formations, collect dynamic power-ups like multi-ball & laser cannons, and clear challenging stages.
instructions: Move your cyber paddle horizontally to deflect the energy orb.
Destroy all bricks in each formation to advance to subsequent stages.
Catch falling power-up capsules to trigger Multi-Ball, Paddle Extension, Laser Cannons, and Explosive Orbs.
Don't let the ball plunge below your paddle boundary!
controls: Mouse / Touch Drag: Move paddle left and right
Space / Tap: Launch ball or fire laser cannons
